messages:
maria: Quick sync — we're running the SI onboarding + Datadog/OTel integration for the GKE marketplace tile next week. Need to align on telemetry artifacts, docs, and joint announcement timeline.

alex: timeline? when's the submission window for the marketplace tile?

maria: marketplace submission cutoff is Tue 03/30 EOD. we'd like the SI onboarding checklist and a dashboard bake by Mon 03/29 so we can run QA.

jin: for the OTel side I can produce a collector config and a sample dashboard. do we want to ship a preconfigured Datadog dashboard JSON as part of the bundle?

sam: +1 to the dashboard. also flagging the hardware SI — NV partner wants a small agent to expose GPU metrics to OTel (power/temp/SM utilization). can we include a note in the marketplace tile that GPU metrics are supported?

maria: yes include GPU metrics support note, but we need the NV partner's telemetry schema. sam, can you get that by Friday?

sam: pinged them, they'll send telemetry schema and sample metrics tomorrow.

jin: drafting a minimal collector config that routes to Datadog APM + metrics. feedback welcome.

jin: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api: ${DATADOG_API_KEY} # replace in docs
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

alex: love the config. can we also add a short snippet showing how to enable prefix caching for Redwood runtime spans? some customers will want SLO correlation.

jin: sure, will add a note in the README with an example tracing attribute: `redwood.runtime.cache_hit=true` and a short query for Datadog.

elaine: for marketing/PR: we'll need a 2-paragraph co-bylined blurb, partner logos (SVGs), and a 1-slide explainer for the launch demo. deadline by next Wed to route through legal.

maria: noted. i'll own the PR draft, elaine can own logo collection and the slide.

sam: ops/packaging question — should the tile include a small HelmValue to preconfigure the collector with Datadog endpoint, or keep it manual? pros/cons: preconfigured is easier but requires API key injection UI.

alex: prefer optional preconfigure but default to manual. include templates for both cases.

maria: sounds good. action items: 1) jin — collector config + DD dashboard JSON (due Mon 03/29) 2) sam — NV telemetry schema (due Fri) 3) elaine — logos & slide (due Tue) 4) alex — SRE/ops QA run (due Mon) 5) maria — PR draft & marketplace submission (due Tue EOD).

dd-bot: Marketplace submission status changed: draft created (tile_id: tile-9081). Review required before final submit.

jin: I'll upload dashboard JSON to the repo under `observability/gke/datadog/` and add the README examples.

alex: once dashboard is in repo i'll run it on a dev cluster and post screenshots here for review.

sam: NV schema received. sending in DM and attaching to the ticket. includes `nvidia.gpu.utilization` and `nvidia.power.draw`.

maria: perfect — i'll update the doc to mention those fields explicitly so the dashboard can chart them.

elaine: quick ask — legal needs a line: "No customer data is sent to Redwood; telemetry is forwarded directly to partner endpoints unless customer opts into Redwood-managed routing." can someone confirm that's accurate for the tile?

jin: confirmed — the supplied Helm template defaults to direct export to Datadog; Redwood-managed routing is opt-in via a flag. I'll add that language to README.

alex: QA note: watch for sampling differences between OTel collector and Datadog agent — may need to harmonize sampling rate. i'll test.

maria: thanks all. i'll update the tracking doc with these AIs and the timeline. please mark items done in the tracker when complete.

sam: quick follow-up — is there a joint webinar planned? ops/prod demo would be helpful.

elaine: yes tentatively scheduling a partner webinar 2 weeks after launch. will coordinate host and audience.

maria: closing the loop: final submit target Tue 03/30. ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
